AgentEvent.description:
AgentEvent is the params of an agent/event notification: one thing that
happened in a turn, as the client draws it. Type says which fields mean
something; the rest are absent.

channel.description: agent_message: Channel is send | reply | post.

content.description:
Content is the text of a delta, a tool's result, a child's goal
(child_started) or summary (child_done), an agent message; the JSON
checklist for todos_updated.

data.description:
Data is the payload of pending_ops (PendingOps), step_usage and
context_estimate (Usage) and mode_route (ModeRoute). DecodeData reads
it on the client side.

depth.description: Depth, Agent and ParentAgent place the child in the delegation tree.

lesson_promote_suggestion.description: Promote suggestions a child's task_result carried (child_done).

scope.description:
Child scope: Scope is "child" on every event a subagent emits and on
the child_* events, with the task and its parent.

session_id.description: SessionID is set for session.message turns; TurnID for every turn.

status.description:
Status is the child's result status on child_done, the verdict on
integration_verify.

task_ids.description: workorders_relayed: the tasks spawned and how many orders were refused.

tier.description: Tier and Model are the child's, on child_started.

tool_call_id.description:
Tool calls: tool_call_start carries the name and id; tool_call_delta
the next piece of the arguments; tool_call_completed the result in
Content and the diagnostics an edit produced. ToolCallIndex tells
parallel calls of one step apart when a model sends no ids.

waiting_for.description: WaitingFor and Reason say why a child_queued task waits.

workers.description: integration_verify: what was checked and the one-line summary.

AgentsDeleteParams.description: AgentsDeleteParams removes a custom agent by name.

AttachmentsStoreParams.description:
AttachmentsStoreParams carries a file's bytes from a client that has no
filesystem of its own — a browser, or the desktop shell's web view — to be
kept under the workspace, where a turn can refer to it. The editor's host
does this itself (ui/vscode/src/chat/panel.ts, "attachBytes"): this is the
same thing for hosts whose only reach into the workspace is the core.

AttachmentsStoreResult.description:
AttachmentsStoreResult is the stored file as a message attachment: the
same fields the renderer's file chips and session.message carry.

path.description: Path is absolute; Rel is workspace-relative with forward slashes.

BrowserCall.description:
BrowserCall is the params of browser/call: a browser.* op for the
client's own browser view. The client answers with the op's result, or
{"error": reason} when it refuses.

Capabilities.description: Capabilities names what a core serves.

requests.description: Requests the core makes of the client, which the client must answer.

ContextBreakdown.description: ContextBreakdown is one category of a prompt-context estimate.

ExecOutputChunk.description:
ExecOutputChunk is the params of exec/output_chunk: a piece of a running
command's output.

scope.description: Child scope, as on AgentEvent, when a subagent's command is running.

FileDiff.description: FileDiff is a file's content before and after a turn's edits.

Health.description: Health is returned by core.health (and /health in HTTP mode).

lsp_install_progress.description: LSPInstallProgress is set while a language server is being provisioned.

min_protocol_version.description:
MinProtocolVersion is the oldest protocol version the core speaks
(ProtocolVersion 24); absent from a core before that.

IndexConfigureParams.description: IndexConfigureParams updates scope + embed settings in .orchestra.yml.

IndexEmbedParams.description: IndexEmbedParams runs vector indexing for CKG nodes.

IndexGraphParams.description:
IndexGraphParams selects the granularity of index.graph: "file" (default)
— folders, files and weighted file-to-file relations, what the Graph view
draws — or "symbol", every indexed symbol with its relations.

IndexOutlineParams.description:
IndexOutlineParams asks for one file's symbols, by workspace-relative path
with forward slashes — the id of a file node in index.graph.

preview.description: Preview off returns the symbol list without reading the file.

IndexRebuildParams.description: IndexRebuildParams triggers a synchronous CKG rescan.

InitializeParams.description:
InitializeParams is the first request of a connection.

Since ProtocolVersion 24 the client names the range of protocol versions
it speaks and the core answers with the newest both sides have. Before
that the number had to match exactly, so a client and a core from
different releases could not connect at all — and tools_version, which
moves with tools the client never calls, was checked the same way.

min_protocol_version.description:
MinProtocolVersion is the oldest it still speaks. Zero means
ProtocolVersion alone, which is what a client before v24 sends.

ops_version.description:
OpsVersion must match the core's when given: internal ops are what
reaches the disk.

protocol_version.description: ProtocolVersion is the newest protocol version the client speaks.

tools_version.description:
ToolsVersion is informational: the core records it and answers with
its own. A client that needs a particular tool checks the answer.

capabilities.description:
Capabilities is what this core serves, by name, so a client asks for
the feature it needs instead of comparing version numbers.

protocol_version.description:
ProtocolVersion is the version both sides speak from here on: the
newest in both ranges (ProtocolVersion 24).

LSPInstallProgress.description: LSPInstallProgress is download/install status for the TUI status bar.

MCPDeleteParams.description: MCPDeleteParams removes a server by name.

MCPPromptArgView.description: MCPPromptArgView is one argument an MCP prompt accepts.

MCPPromptCommand.description:
MCPPromptCommand is one MCP prompt as a slash command a person can run.

An MCP prompt is the server's own recipe, meant for a human to pick — not
for the model to call. So it belongs in the command palette next to /model
and /skill, not in the tool list.

slash.description:
Slash and Hint are the rendered palette row. They travel over the wire
so the TUI and the VS Code panel do not each re-derive the formatting
and drift apart.

MCPPromptGetParams.description:
MCPPromptGetParams names the prompt to render. Args is the raw text typed
after the command; the core maps it onto the prompt's declared arguments.

MCPPromptGetResult.description: MCPPromptGetResult carries the text to send as the user's turn.

MCPServerParams.description: MCPServerParams is the JSON shape for one MCP server (upsert / test).

MCPServerView.description: MCPServerView is one row in mcp.list.

MCPTestParams.description: MCPTestParams probes a server config (or named cfg entry) without persisting.

MCPTestResult.description: MCPTestResult lists tools from a temporary connection.

MCPUpsertParams.description: MCPUpsertParams adds or replaces a server by name.

MCPUpsertResult.description: MCPUpsertResult is returned after upsert + hot reload.

MemoryNote.description:
MemoryNote says what the end-of-turn memory writer did. Outcome is
written | skipped | failed; Source is model | digest; Detail is the note
when written, the reason otherwise.

ModeRoute.description: ModeRoute is the Data of a mode_route event.

OpsApplyResult.description: OpsApplyResult reports the result of applying pending ops.

PendingOps.description:
PendingOps is the Data of a pending_ops event: the internal ops a turn
staged (or applied, when Applied), with a before/after diff per file.
Ops are patch/ops objects (type, path, …), which the client sends back
as they are to session.apply_pending; the protocol module does not
decode them.

PermissionDecision.description:
PermissionDecision answers permission/request. Always asks the core to
remember the decision for the session.

PermissionRequest.description:
PermissionRequest is the params of permission/request. Kind is "" or
"exec" for a shell command, "lsp.install" for a language server.

QuestionAnswers.description: QuestionAnswers answers question/ask, one answer per question.

QuestionAsk.description: QuestionAsk is the params of question/ask.

QuestionItem.description: QuestionItem is one question for the person.

RuleSuggestion.description:
RuleSuggestion offers the person a project rule for a repeated
anti-pattern. Text is the chat-facing prompt; RuleLine is the exact line
lesson.rule_respond appends to ORCHESTRA.md on accept.

RuntimeConfigureLLMParams.description: RuntimeConfigureLLMParams updates connection fields. Empty api_key leaves the existing key.

RuntimeConfigureLLMResult.description: RuntimeConfigureLLMResult mirrors set_model-ish outcome after configure.

RuntimeConfigureOrchestraProviderPatch.description: RuntimeConfigureOrchestraProviderPatch updates one named provider snapshot.

RuntimeCreditsParams.description:
RuntimeCreditsParams selects which provider's balance to query.
Empty Provider uses the primary llm config.

RuntimeCreditsResult.description:
RuntimeCreditsResult is returned by runtime.credits. Supported=false means
the provider has no balance API we know (local servers, plain OpenAI base).

RuntimeGetLLMResult.description: RuntimeGetLLMResult exposes current LLM connection settings (key masked).

RuntimeGetOrchestraParams.description: RuntimeGetOrchestraParams is empty — reads current .orchestra.yml orchestra block.

RuntimeGetOrchestraResult.description: RuntimeGetOrchestraResult exposes orchestra planner/tiers for settings UI.

RuntimeListModelsParams.description: RuntimeListModelsParams selects which credential set to use for /models.

include_secrets.description: IncludeSecrets returns api_key in entries (settings UI only — local trusted client).

probe.description: Probe fetches /models for each configured (ready) provider. Default false.

probe_key.description: ProbeKey limits probe to one provider key (catalog or named).

RuntimeModelEntry.description: RuntimeModelEntry is one remote model id.

RuntimeOrchestraNamedProvider.description: RuntimeOrchestraNamedProvider is a named providers: entry snapshot for UI.

RuntimeOrchestraRole.description: RuntimeOrchestraRole is one editable orchestra role row.

RuntimeProviderEntry.description: RuntimeProviderEntry is one selectable provider in settings UI.

RuntimeSetModelParams.description:
RuntimeSetModelParams switches the active LLM model for this core process.
Optionally persists to .orchestra.yml (default persist=true).

persist.description: Persist writes llm.model (and provider mirror) to disk. nil → true.

provider.description: named providers: key; empty keeps current

RuntimeSetSystemPromptParams.description: RuntimeSetSystemPromptParams writes or clears the system override.

persist.description: persist prompt_family to yaml; default true

paths.description: optional: apply only ops whose path matches one of these (workspace-relative)

query.description: optional goal hint for the summary

paths.description: optional: discard only ops whose path matches one of these (workspace-relative)

session_id.description:
SessionID optionally reopens an existing on-disk session (v2 snapshot).
When empty, core allocates a new sortable id.

resumable_turn_id.description:
ResumableTurnID names the session's most recent turn its core did not
finish — a crash, a kill — which session.message{resume} continues.
Empty when there is none. (ProtocolVersion 25.)

SessionTrajectoryParams.description: SessionTrajectoryParams selects the session whose log to read.

Signature.description:
Signature names a method's params and result types on the wire. An empty
name means the method has none (core.health takes no params) or that the
type stays in internal/core because it carries a type of the patch module
(ops.AnyOp, patches.Patch), of the config, of the session snapshot or of
the code graph; docs/PROTOCOL.md describes those.

TodoItem.description: TodoItem is one row of the model's checklist.

ToolDiagnostic.description: ToolDiagnostic is one LSP diagnostic an edit produced, 1-based.

Usage.description:
Usage is token spend: the Data of step_usage (one LLM call, measured by
the provider) and context_estimate (a byte-derived estimate of the next
prompt, Source "estimate", with its Breakdown), and the turn's total in
agent.run and session.message results. The estimate and the measurement
must never be summed or substituted for one another.

breakdown.description: Breakdown is the per-category split of an estimate.

cached_prompt_tokens.description:
CachedPromptTokens is the part of PromptTokens the provider served
from its prompt cache; CacheWriteTokens is what it charged to fill it.

entries.description: Entries is the per-(provider, model) split of a turn.

UsageEntry.description: UsageEntry is one (provider, model) row of a turn's spend.

VersionRange.description: VersionRange is the protocol versions one side speaks, inclusive.

WorkflowStage.description: WorkflowStage is the params of workflow/stage_start and workflow/stage_done.

WorkspaceTrustParams.description:
WorkspaceTrustParams is the workspace.trust request. Revoke forgets the
workspace instead of trusting it.
